global_scale.semantics: The vertical (Y) data scale is linear from 0 to 1000 mapped to pixels from y=198.4 (value 0) up to y=54.1 (value 1000). If data extrema or the axis domain change, the pixel-per-unit ratio MUST be recomputed and the y-coordinates and heights of all bars and the path control points of both line series MUST be remapped so equal data increments remain equal pixel distances.

The horizontal (X) categorical scale maps the 12 month categories Jan–Dec to equally spaced tick positions along the axis domain line. If category order or axis length changes, the x positions of bar centers and line vertices MUST shift so that each logical category remains horizontally aligned with its tick.

proportionality.semantics: Within the Total Workload bar series, each bar’s data value is encoded as its vertical extent above the baseline. The height in pixels MUST remain proportional to the underlying data value according to the shared Y-axis linear scale (0–1000 mapped to 198.4–54.1). Changing any bar’s data value or the Y-axis domain requires recalculating that bar’s height so that ratios between bar heights equal ratios between their data values.

alignment.semantics: Each horizontal grid line MUST share the same y-coordinate as its corresponding Y-axis tick. If a tick’s y-position changes (e.g., due to rescaling), the matching grid line’s y1 and y2 MUST be updated to exactly that value to preserve alignment.

All bar bottoms MUST sit exactly on the shared baseline defined by the X-axis domain line and the Y-axis 0 tick. If the baseline y-position moves, every bar’s y or height MUST be adjusted so that y + height equals the new baseline.

The horizontal positions of bar groups and line-feature vertices MUST remain locked to the categorical ticks. If tick positions shift (e.g., change in tick_step or axis length), the corresponding marks’ x coordinates MUST be translated by the same delta to maintain category alignment.

intra_group_spacing.semantics: Within the Total Workload bar group, all bars MUST share the same width and horizontal padding. If one bar’s width or x-position is changed, sibling bars MUST be repositioned so that the inter-bar gap and center-to-center spacing remain uniform.

collision_avoidance.semantics: Axis labels and chart titles are placed outside the plot area and MUST avoid overlapping the bars and lines. If text content or font size increases such that bounding boxes would collide with marks, the plot area (or text positions) MUST be adjusted, for example by increasing margins or shifting the plot region inward.

category_binding.semantics: The legend entry for 'Total Workload' and all bars encoding this series MUST share the same visual style. Changing the series color or stroke-width in one place requires updating the other to match.
The legend entry for 'Max Capacity' and the corresponding line series MUST share the same stroke color and width. Any change to the series styling MUST be reflected in the legend swatch.
The legend entry for 'Error Overhead' and its line series MUST use the same stroke color and width so viewers can correctly associate the legend with the plotted series.

z_order_occlusion.semantics: Bars form a dense background and MUST be rendered earlier in the SVG DOM, while the thinner line series MUST be placed later so they appear on top and remain visible. If DOM order changes, it MUST preserve this layering: bar rects behind, Max Capacity and Error Overhead paths in front.
